tools.name: search
tools.description: find traders and coins on copy.top by name, handle, @x, $ticker or address. use it to resolve a name before the other tools.

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: a trader's copy.top profile (fomo or pump.fun): pnl 30d (realized, unrealized, total), roi, win rate, fair play verdict and badges, followers, copiers, platforms, largest open positions, latest trades and theses.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: rank traders like copy.top's discover page. window 1d, 7d or 30d; sort total (pnl), realized, roi, winrate or copiers; optional chain or platform (fomo, pumpfun); fair_play clean or clean_or_watch keeps only those.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: a coin's copy.top page: price, market cap, 1h and 24h moves, liquidity, which tracked traders hold it or sold it and their pnl on it, and their theses.

tools.name: get_theses
tools.description: the latest or most popular theses (a trader's written reason for holding a coin) posted by tracked traders in the last 24 h at most, with the coin and their pnl at post.

tools.name: get_hot_coins
tools.description: the signal feed: coins tracked traders are buying now. window 1h or 24h, optional max market cap in dollars. each coin: how many traders and top traders bought, dollars bought and sold, minutes since the first buy, and the first buyers.

tools.name: get_live_trades
tools.description: the live tape: the latest buys and sells by tracked traders (fomo and pump.fun), newest first. optional since (iso time or the cursor of a previous call) to get only newer trades, side buy or sell, min_usd.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: events since a cursor, for alert bots: confluence (several top traders bought the same coin recently), big_trade (one tracked trader bought or sold a large amount) and thesis (a tracked trader posted a thesis). pass the cursor of the previous call as since; without since, the last 15 minutes. thresh

tools.name: get_hot_index
tools.description: copy.top's hot index: coins ranked 0-100 by attention right now, mixing tracked traders buying, callers and x activity (voices, views). window 1h, 6h or 24h; optional chain.

tools.name: get_money_flow
tools.description: where tracked traders' dollars go: coins ranked by dollars bought (side buy) or sold (side sell) over 1h, 6h, 24h or 7d, with the number of traders.

tools.name: get_dex_paid
tools.description: coins whose team paid for a dexscreener profile in the last 24 h (a sign the team is spending), with price, market cap, liquidity, volume and moves.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_theses, get_hot_coins · Private data: get_token · Public sink: get_theses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_theses, get_hot_coins · Private data: get_token · Public sink: get_theses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
